text: Sample Business Expense Policy
This sample policy is for testing the RAG knowledge base and is not an official company policy.
Approval: Get manager approval before making a business purchase over $100. Purchases over $500 also require department-head approval.
Reimbursement: Submit an expense report with an itemized receipt within 30 days of the purchase. Include the business purpose and project or client name when relevant.
Meals: Reasonable business meals may be reimbursed when they have a clear work purpose. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
Travel: Book standard economy airfare and reasonably priced lodging. Obtain manager approval before booking travel.
Personal expenses: Personal purchases, traffic fines, and expenses without a business purpose are not reimbursable.
Sample Human Resources Policy
This sample policy is for testing the RAG knowledge base and is not an official company policy.
Work hours: The standard schedule is 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. Teams may agree on different schedules with their manager.
Respectful workplace: Employees must treat colleagues, customers, and visitors respectfully. Harassment, discrimination, bullying, and retaliation are not allowed. Report concerns to HR or a manager.
Confidential information: Protect employee records, customer information, passwords, and internal business documents. Share confidential information only with people who need it for their work.
Performance reviews: Managers should hold a formal performance review with each employee twice per year. Employees may request a check-in with their manager at any time.
Questions: Contact the HR team for help with benefits, workplace concerns, or policy interpretation.
Sample Leave Policy
This sample policy applies to full-time employees. It is for testing the RAG knowledge base and is not an official company policy.
Annual leave: Employees receive 18 paid annual-leave days per calendar year. Submit requests to your manager at least five working days in advance when possible. Approval depends on team coverage.

Sick leave: Employees receive 8 paid sick days per year. Tell your manager as soon as practical when illness prevents you from working. A medical certificate may be requested for absences longer than three consecutive working days.
Parental leave: Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of parental leave. Contact HR at least 30 days before the expected start date when possible to discuss eligibility and arrangements.
Unused annual leave: Up to 5 unused annual-leave days may be carried into the next calendar year. Carried days must be used by March 31 or they expire.
Sample Remote Work Policy
This sample policy is for testing the RAG knowledge base and is not an official company policy.
Eligibility: Remote work requires manager approval and depends on the employee's role and team needs.
Availability: Remote employees should be reachable during their agreed working hours and attend scheduled team meetings. Update your calendar when you will be unavailable.
Equipment and security: Use company-approved devices and secure network connections. Lock your screen when away and do not let others use your work device.
Expenses: Ask your manager for written approval before purchasing equipment or services for remote work. Submit approved expenses with receipts within 30 days.
Changes: Managers may review or change remote-work arrangements when business needs change.
